Age model from a filtered cycle

Source: R/tools_timeseries.R
cd_cycle_agemodel.Rd

Finds the maxima (or minima) of a filtered series and gives each one an age one cycle period after the previous one, as in the Build Age Model tool of Acycle (minimal tuning).

Usage

cd_cycle_agemodel(data, cycle = 405, use = "max", pts = 3, t0 = 0)

Arguments

data

Data frame or matrix: depth in column 1, filtered series in column 2.

cycle

Period of the filtered cycle in kyr (numeric, > 0). Default=405.

use

Tie points at the maxima ("max") or minima ("min"). Default="max".

pts

Half-width of the search window in points: a sample is a maximum when it is the largest within pts samples on either side (integer, >= 1). Default=3.

t0

Age of the first tie point in kyr (numeric). Default=0.

Value

A data frame with columns depth and age_kyr.
